## Shared contract 1 - the C1 candidate's CLI

`/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/tools/mado-filetype.py` (target path; the in-wave draft is /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-97/build/mado-filetype.py, owned by R97MExecToolC1):
```
mado-filetype.py PATH... [--follow|--nofollow] [--fast] [--data-home D | --data-home-unset]
                 [--data-dirs LIST | --data-dirs-unset] [--home H | --home-unset] [--json]
mado-filetype.py --selftest
```
Default is `--follow` and the full attribute (`standard::content-type`). It models GIO 2.90.1 `GLocalFileInfo`'s `get_content_type` (glocalfileinfo.c:1300-1389) for each PATH: the stat branches first (symlink broken/nofollow -> `inode/symlink`; dir -> `inode/directory`; char -> `inode/chardevice`; block -> `inode/blockdevice`; fifo -> `inode/fifo`; regular size 0 -> `application/x-zerosize`; socket -> `inode/socket`), else the name-only guess on the basename (round 94's `tools/mado-mimeglob.py`), then - only when not `--fast` and the name-only answer is uncertain - a sniff of the file with `sniff_length = max_buffer_extents` clamped to 16384 (0 or > 16384 -> 16384), opened `O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC` (the O_NOATIME retry is modelled, not observable), re-guessing with `(basename, data, res)`; an open/read failure keeps the name-only answer. Output: one `MADO_FILETYPE: <type> attr=<full|fast> mode=<follow|nofollow> path=<escaped>` line per path, plus one `MADO_FILETYPE_DIRS: db=<cache|text|none>` line. A path that cannot be stat'ed prints `MADO_FILETYPE: ERROR stat path=<escaped>` and the tool exits 2 (no other path is lost: the line is printed for that path only). `--selftest` prints `MADO_FILETYPE_SELFTEST_FAIL: <label>` per failing check and `MADO_FILETYPE_SELFTEST: checks=N failed=0` (stdout, N>=20), exit 0/1.
